tasks.short: Monitor gas plant equipment and perform unit checks

steps.what: Monitor equipment functioning, observe gauges and perform regular unit checks against the operating procedure

tasks.design: Retain the operator's observation and unit checks, using the plant monitoring system in {OTHER} and procedures in {DOCS}. Existing sensors and alarms support the operator; their runtime does not replace the remaining physical checks or judgement.
tasks.previous_blocker: The operator must recognise actual equipment conditions that individual readings may not explain.
tasks.enabler_now: The digest establishes digital rounds and records, rather than removal of the substantive unit inspection.
tasks.still_hard: Distinguishing a faulty reading from an abnormal process and recognising uninstrumented conditions.
tasks.human_edge: The operator can compare instruments with the actual unit and question inconsistent signals.
tasks.altitude: Nothing changes in unit monitoring, physical checking or control authority.

reach.task: Describe an observed equipment concern precisely
reach.learn: Equipment identifiers and evidence for abnormal conditions

evidence.claim: AVEVA Mobile Operator with PI System supports digital rounds feeding the historian; this does not demonstrate removal of physical unit checks.

assumptions: Boundary is the operator's monitoring and unit inspection, excluding separate record compilation, fault diagnosis and equipment control actions.

OTHER means the plant monitoring system. The operator directly checks equipment identity, current temperature, level and flow indications, instrument condition and physical observations during s1. Capture and interpretation remain fully counted.

Existing instruments produce live readings; the operator verifies their relevance. No free structured unit-healthy or gauge-valid flag is assumed. Unclear or conflicting indications require manual checking and escalation.
Use existing native monitoring functions. No new sensor, analytics model or process is introduced, so incremental upkeep is zero.
unknowns: Instrument coverage and the actual scope of physical rounds
research_questions: Is there any distinct duplicate recording beyond the physical monitoring task?

already_counted.description: Observe current equipment and gauges and perform the unit checks

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100 gives gross0 and net0 with zero upkeep. Routine rounds and conflicting gauge indications both retain full physical observation and checking time; existing sensor runtime earns no saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Record, review and compile operating and test data

steps.what: Record field observations and identify the operations records, test results and gauge readings needed
Compile the selected operations data and gauge readings into the shift record
Review compiled readings, investigate missing or conflicting entries and confirm the shift record

tasks.design: Configure native shift-record compilation from the plant historian and rounds record in {OTHER}, replacing repeated copying into {SPREADSHEET} and {DOCS}. The operator still captures field observations, selects the correct records and checks completeness and meaning before confirming the shift record.
tasks.previous_blocker: Readings and notes can be copied from existing plant records into a separate shift log.
tasks.enabler_now: Native logbook and historian reporting can assemble referenced values without a model deciding plant condition.
tasks.still_hard: Detecting stale readings, wrong tags, missing context and an apparently complete but misleading log.
tasks.human_edge: The operator knows whether the record describes what actually happened during the shift.
tasks.altitude: Less duplicate log compilation; field capture and handover accountability remain unchanged.

reach.task: Provide a complete record with unresolved data issues clearly identified
reach.learn: Tag provenance, timestamp alignment and handover conventions

evidence.claim: Shiftconnector supports digital handover using sensor data and field notes; j5 supports standard log entries and automatic reports in an LNG operations case.
Model knowledge: replacing repeated compilation may save operator labour, but the proposed task split and saving are unmeasured.

assumptions: Boundary is record capture, compilation and review, excluding physical unit inspection, testing, abnormality diagnosis and control actions. Observation or capture shared with another task must be assigned once in a roll-up.

OTHER means the plant historian and rounds logbook. In s1 the operator produces shift and unit references, selected tag IDs, date and time ranges, units, field values, observation notes, test result references and quality concerns. All manual capture, selection and reconciliation remain fully counted.

Existing plant instruments and test personnel produce the original timestamped readings and results. The machine copies those sources only after the operator selects them; missing provenance or unmapped fields require manual compilation and checking in s3.

An instrumentation or logbook owner maintains tag definitions and export maps; added work is charged to other_role. Test native logbook configuration first, with access and national consultation requirements assessed during rollout.
Only actual repeated human compilation is removed. Existing historian collection, report runtime and unstaffed waiting earn no labour saving.
unknowns: Whether shift records already compile automatically
Tag and timestamp quality and access permissions
research_questions: Can native compilation remove copying while retaining field capture and finding stale, missing and wrong-tag entries?

already_counted.description: Capture and select records and review the final shift log

incremental.description: Resolve compilation exceptions and verify changed log mappings
Maintain tag maps, report templates and access controls

approvals.approved_version: Exact shift record snapshot, source tags and ranges, field notes, test references and unresolved concerns checked before confirmation; changes void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R65 gives gross35, less focal upkeep7 gives net28. Range0-6 assumes much compilation already uses historian data and only a minority of duplicate copying remains; field capture and review stay full time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Determine causes of abnormal pressure and recommend corrections

steps.what: Determine causes of abnormal pressure variances and recommend corrective options from checked operating evidence

tasks.design: Keep pressure diagnosis and corrective recommendations with the operator, supported by plant monitoring in {OTHER} and equipment references in {DOCS}. A trend is evidence for investigation, not an automatic cause or authority to change pipework or operating limits.
tasks.previous_blocker: Different equipment and process problems can produce similar pressure symptoms.
tasks.enabler_now: The supplied digest does not demonstrate autonomous cause determination or corrective engineering recommendations.
tasks.still_hard: Distinguishing instrumentation faults, operating changes and physical restrictions or overloads.
tasks.human_edge: The operator can inspect the actual process and challenge a plausible but incomplete explanation.
tasks.altitude: Nothing changes in diagnostic responsibility or engineering change authority.

reach.task: Provide a pressure-variance hypothesis with supporting and conflicting observations
reach.learn: Process limits and engineering change boundaries

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: pressure-variance diagnosis and corrective recommendations require plant-specific judgement; no task labour saving is established by the supplied digest.

assumptions: Boundary is cause investigation and recommendation, excluding routine monitoring, log compilation, control action and engineering implementation.

OTHER means the plant monitoring system. The operator checks affected unit and pressure tags, times, units, related operating changes, instrument condition and physical observations during s1. Capture and interpretation remain fully counted.
No structured root-cause, overload or safe-remedy flag is assumed. Missing or inconsistent evidence requires manual investigation and engineering escalation.
Use existing native trends and references. No new diagnostic model, integration or process is introduced, so incremental upkeep is zero.
unknowns: Equipment configuration and the operator's diagnostic and recommendation remit
research_questions: Is there repeated evidence collation distinct from causal investigation and already counted log compilation?

already_counted.description: Investigate pressure evidence and recommend qualified corrective options

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100 gives gross0 and net0 with zero upkeep. A familiar pressure symptom and an unexplained variance retain full causal investigation and recommendation time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Collaborate with operators to solve unit problems

steps.what: Collaborate with other operators to compare observations and agree how to investigate unit problems

tasks.design: Retain problem-solving discussion and coordination with the operators, using existing references in {DOCS}. No invented meeting-preparation baseline or automatic operating decision is introduced.
tasks.previous_blocker: Solving a unit problem requires reconciling observations and coordinating people under current conditions.
tasks.enabler_now: Digital records can inform the discussion but do not establish removal of this collaborative work.
tasks.still_hard: Recognising inconsistent accounts and agreeing a clear, appropriate next action.
tasks.human_edge: The operator can ask immediate questions and confirm that colleagues understand the same situation.
tasks.altitude: Nothing changes in collaboration time or operating authority.

reach.task: Explain unresolved unit concerns and coordination needs

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: live operator collaboration remains human; the digest's digital handover tools do not establish a substantive discussion-time saving.

assumptions: Boundary is the focal operator's collaborative discussion, excluding colleagues' time and subsequent diagnosis, control actions or maintenance.

The operator establishes unit identity, observed symptoms, uncertainty, current constraints and next-action ownership during s1. Capture and clarification remain fully counted; no structured resolved-problem flag is assumed.
Colleagues supply their actual observations during the discussion. Conflicts or missing information require direct clarification rather than a generated consensus.
Use existing native records and communication channels. No new process is introduced, so incremental upkeep is zero.
unknowns: Whether any separate repetitive discussion preparation exists
research_questions: Can time sampling isolate repeated record retrieval without reducing problem-solving or acknowledgement time?

already_counted.description: Compare observations, clarify disagreements and coordinate next steps

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100 gives gross0 and net0 with zero upkeep. Routine unit coordination and conflicting operator observations both retain full discussion and clarification time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Reduce repeated operating-record compilation while retaining unit observation, diagnosis and collaborative problem solving.
reach: Provide incoming operators with traceable shift records
Give plant engineers qualified pressure-variance evidence
role.ambitious_version: A gas plant operator who spends less time copying readings and retains full attention for actual equipment condition and coordinated problem solving.
